messages:
maria: Found a parity bug: Go and Node SDKs behave differently from REST for /v1/chat/stream in starter-kit. SDKs never emit SSE frames; curl works.

lee: what headers are the SDKs sending?

maria: SDKs set Accept: application/json or Accept: */*; curl uses Accept: text/event-stream. Server selects streaming mode based on Accept.

own: also noticed optional numeric fields (response_tokens, max_tokens) end up as null in SDK payloads sometimes, while REST omits them. Server treats null as explicit zero and closes stream early.

lee: root cause sounds like twofold: header default + encoder coercion of undefined -> null.

own: short plan:
- SDKs: special-case stream endpoints to set Accept: text/event-stream and support raw SSE body reader. unit tests.
- Encoder: stop converting undefined numbers to null; preserve omission semantics.
- CI: add a lightweight e2e comparing curl vs sdk for stream endpoints; fail fast if Accept header differs.

ci-bot: Created tasks DEVX-820 (stream Accept header), DEVX-821 (numeric-param-null-serialization), DEVX-822 (ci stream parity test).

maria: i'll open a starter-kit PR to mark the flaky test, attach tcpdump + minimal curl repro.

lee: i'll take header change + tests. owen you ok to handle encoder fix?

own: yeah, will add unit tests comparing SDK serialization to REST fixtures. will run go vet/js lint.

maria: small onboarding doc update request: include quick curl check and how to dump headers, new hires waste hours on this.

lee: agreed. add a checklist to quickstart: verify SSE with curl, confirm Accept header.

maria: timeline: header PR today, encoder fix by EOD, CI job next week.

ci-bot: Linked PRs: #401 (starter-kit flaky test), #402 (sdk: stream accept).

maria: thanks — drop raw headers here if you hit more.
